why: Two rules meet here. The language boundary (.github/language-boundaries.toml, cloud-core-swift-minimal) refuses a new Swift file in CmuxNextCloud and CmuxNextCloudCredentials, the Cloud domain packages. The rule itself is already Rust (cmux-cloud-start-core agent_check, #41135). What is left is app-side glue that Rust cannot do without a network stack in the app FFI: a Keychain read, one URLSession probe, and a per-person cache of the rule's answer. So that glue sits in CmuxNextApp/Cloud. The independent review at the previous head covered the same code, before it moved.
author: red1 cloud-composer lane (claude opus)
owner: red1 cloud-composer lane: move the probe and cache into Rust once the app FFI can send HTTP, or into the Cloud package if the boundary allows it
